source_gaps_resolved_in_proposal: General known-cost Groves ledger and conditional pivot IR
Nonsmooth pointwise/interim payment characterization with constants
BIC global revenue upper bound under independent laws
Global first-price/all-pay deviations, not only first-order conditions
CARA counterexample to retaining the risk-neutral equilibrium; no new risk-averse-equilibrium claim
retained_boundaries: Revelation reproduces a selected equilibrium, not unique/full implementation; communication and hidden actions outside the simulated outcome are excluded.
BIC revelation can retain correlated type laws, but the one-variable interim envelope and virtual-revenue theorem assume independence.
Random expected payments require per-report and ex ante absolute integrability/joint measurability; finite/bounded examples satisfy them.
Known distribution, fixed participation population, private values, commitment, no binding budgets and enforced transfers are substantive model assumptions.
The proposed CARA utility is finite, increasing and concave on all real monetary gains, so no hidden overbid-domain restriction is needed.
